social_circle.name: Karen Porterfield

demographics.education: high school graduate with veterinary technician training or certification classes

background.how_they_met: Karen is Janell's mother and has raised her in Sherburne.
background.why_close: Karen is Janell's main emotional support, helps her think through social stress, encourages her animal and science interests, and manages much of the family calendar.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, practical full sentences with reminders, check-ins, and occasional gentle teasing. Uses punctuation and a few emojis but mostly sounds like a busy parent coordinating logistics.

shared_activities: talking through school and friendship stress
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Janell has practice, rehearsal, student council, or needs a ride home.
Helping Janell calm down after friendship stress or a packed school week.
Reminding Janell about sleep, homework, allergy medicine, forms, and packing soccer gear.
Talking about Scout, the animal shelter, and Janell's wildlife or veterinary interests.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Janell's mom Karen is the person she talks to when stressed or when something social happens at school, and Q49 says Janell talks to her mom for emotional support. Q103-Q104 identify Karen's veterinary clinic work.

social_circle.name: Mike Porterfield

demographics.education: high school graduate with technical repair and mechanical training

background.how_they_met: Mike is Janell's father and has been present throughout her childhood.
background.why_close: They spend a lot of one-on-one time during soccer season because he drives her to practices and games. He helps Janell break problems down practically when she is overwhelmed.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and directly, often about pickup times, weather, gear, or practical next steps. Uses short questions like 'What is the actual problem?' and rarely uses emoji.

shared_activities: watching or discussing sports at home
planning around soccer games and school events
recent_text_topics: Confirming soccer pickup times and whether Janell packed cleats, water, and her brace.
Talking through busy weeks when soccer, drama, and tests pile up.
Discussing Knicks or Bills games that are on at home.
Checking whether an older piece of gear still works before buying something new.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Mike fixes things, drives Janell to soccer, and asks what the actual problem is before she spirals. Q05 also says some of their best talks happen in the car after practice. Q106-Q107 describe his maintenance and equipment repair work.
